Odaseva provides enterprise data management and security solutions that help organizations exercise sovereignty over their critical data.
Companies representing 10% of global market capitalization trust Odaseva, including Schneider Electric, Volkswagen and Robert Half.
Its Excalibur Data Platform enables customers to protect, secure, move, and use data and code independently of application vendors.
The platform supports complex and high-volume use cases, including backup, archiving, zero-copy, BCDR & High Availability, data federation, and semantic AI orchestration.
Customer-controlled end-to-end encryption raises the bar for enterprise security.
With 11 patents, Odaseva manages 50 trillion records and supports 100 million users. 

Your Role

You will join a dynamic Finance team of 7 people in an environment driven by continuous growth and international development.

Reporting directly to the Senior Director, you will play a key role in ensuring accounting accuracy while actively contributing to key projects and transformation initiatives.

In this role, you will maintain accounting operations on NetSuite for 6 international entities and participate in group consolidation processes.

We are looking for someone with strong technical accounting expertise combined with an appetite for change, eager to drive or participate in major strategic projects within a scaling company.


Key Responsibilities

  • Accounting & Treasury Management:

  • Post bank entries and perform daily/monthly bank reconciliations.

  • Manage vendor invoices via our digital processing tool, directing them through approval workflows.

  • Prepare payment runs, perform accounts payable reconciliation, and manage vendor follow-ups/relations.

  • Perform accounts receivable matching and reconciliation.

  • Perform payroll accounting entry integration.

  • Apply analytical accounting principles across your perimeter.

  • Asset Management, Tax & Group Reporting:

  • Perform fixed asset accounting, tracking, and reconciliation.

  • Prepare monthly closing operations (cut-off entries, accruals, VAT, exchange variance analysis, etc.).

  • Prepare French tax declarations (DAS2, VAT, and other local taxes).

  • Manage US Sales Tax compliance

  • Contribute to monthly financial reporting and participate in the Group consolidation process.

  • Ensure daily maintenance of accounting ledgers in compliance with company rules, accounting standards, quality, and deadlines.

  • Support annual statutory audit processes.

  • Projects & Change Management:

  • Actively lead or participate in high-impact finance projects, process automation, and system enhancements.

  • Embrace and drive change to support the scaling of our international finance organization.


    • Required Qualifications

  • Experience & Technical Skills:

  • Degree in Accounting or Finance (e.g., DCG, DSCG, or equivalent).

  • 5+ years of experience in a similar accounting role within an international group or fast-paced environment.

  • Hands-on experience with NetSuite (familiarity with CSV imports, FAM module, Saved Searches, and multi-currency/multi-entity setups) is required.

  • Strong technical accounting expertise (Local GAAP, closing operations, fixed assets, French taxes).

  • Soft Skills & Mindset:

  • Appetite for Change & Project-Driven: You thrive in scaling, evolving environments and enjoy driving or contributing to major transformation projects.

  • Rigor & Organization: You believe structured methods and precision are the keys to operational success.

  • Language: Professional English proficiency (written and spoken) to interact effectively within a global team and environment.


    • Where you'll be
  • Based in Paris (75002), France.
  • Hybrid: 3 days in the office / 2 days remote work.
  • Full time permanent contract position.
    • Who We Are
    At Odaseva, we believe in fostering an inclusive, supportive work environment where talented people can innovate and grow. Our culture is built on being smart, humble, hardworking, and above all—collaborative.
     
    Our core values define who we are: Trust, Customer Centricity, Engagement, Excellence, Continuous Innovation, and Teamwork.
     
    Inclusive & Diverse – We champion equality and embrace diversity.
    Supportive & Collaborative – A team of smart, kind professionals who uplift each other through teamwork, not competition.
    Excellence with a Casual Touch – High professional standards in a relaxed, approachable work culture.
    Impact-Driven – A place where you can truly make a difference and advance your career.
    Innovators in Data & Cloud – Leading the way in cutting-edge technology and solutions.
    Competitive & Rewarding – Offering industry-leading compensation and benefits.
    Truly Global – With offices in Paris, San Francisco, Sydney, and London, and a worldwide presence.
    Flexible Work Environment – We support a hybrid, flexible office culture.
     
    At Odaseva, we are an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) employer. We consider all applicants for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability status.

Vous aimez vendre, convaincre et aller directement à la rencontre de vos clients ?

Chez SumUp, nous aidons les commerçants du quotidien à développer leur activité grâce à des solutions de paiement et de gestion simples, accessibles et performantes.

Dans le cadre de notre croissance en France, nous recherchons un(e) commercial(e) terrain prêt(e) à partir à la conquête de nouveaux clients. Il s'agit d'un poste 100 % terrain : vous rencontrez directement les commerçants de votre secteur, identifiez leurs besoins, leur présentez nos solutions et les accompagnez jusqu'à la signature.

Votre rémunération

Nous faisons le choix de la transparence dès le début du processus :

  • 30 000 € bruts annuels de salaire fixe
  • 27 600 € bruts annuels de variable cible, à 100 % des objectifs
  • Soit un package cible de 57 600 € bruts annuels
  • Un variable entièrement déplafonné : les commerciaux les plus performants peuvent dépasser 100 000 € bruts de rémunération annuelle totale

Les modalités précises du plan de commissionnement vous seront présentées pendant le processus de recrutement.

Vos missions

  • Prospecter directement les commerçants de votre secteur : restaurateurs, artisans, indépendants et commerces de proximité
  • Comprendre leurs besoins et leur présenter les solutions SumUp les plus adaptées
  • Réaliser des démonstrations claires et convaincantes de nos produits
  • Négocier et conclure vos ventes directement sur le terrain
  • Gérer l'intégralité du cycle de vente, du premier contact jusqu'à la signature
  • Développer durablement votre secteur grâce à une prospection régulière et structurée
  • Suivre vos résultats et ajuster votre approche pour atteindre et dépasser vos objectifs

Ce que nous vous proposons

  • Une formation complète et régulière à nos produits et à nos méthodes de vente
  • Un accompagnement de proximité pour développer rapidement vos compétences commerciales
  • Une grande autonomie dans l'organisation et le développement de votre secteur
  • Un environnement dynamique, international et orienté vers la performance
  • Une opportunité de rejoindre le secteur de la tech et de la fintech
  • Des perspectives d'évolution vers des fonctions commerciales seniors ou d'encadrement

Ce poste est fait pour vous si

  • Vous avez déjà une expérience concrète de la prospection à froid, idéalement sur le terrain
  • Vous êtes à l'aise pour aborder des prospects qui ne connaissent pas encore SumUp et susciter leur intérêt
  • Vous aimez la vente terrain, la prospection directe et le contact humain
  • Vous savez créer rapidement une relation de confiance
  • Vous faites preuve d'aisance orale, d'énergie et de force de conviction
  • Vous savez rebondir face aux objections et rester motivé(e) dans un environnement exigeant
  • Vous êtes autonome, organisé(e), persévérant(e) et orienté(e) vers les résultats
  • Vous aimez les objectifs ambitieux et souhaitez avoir un impact direct sur votre rémunération
  • Vous parlez couramment français et disposez d'un niveau d'anglais vous permettant de participer à des échanges internes

Une expérience préalable en prospection à froid est indispensable pour réussir dans ce poste.

Vos avantages

En complément de votre rémunération, vous bénéficiez notamment de :

  • 25 jours de congés payés, auxquels s'ajoutent les jours fériés et des jours de congé spéciaux offerts par SumUp (anniversaire, déménagement...)
  • Break4Me : un mois de congé sabbatique entièrement rémunéré après trois ans d'ancienneté
  • Titres-restaurant de 12 € par jour travaillé
  • Une solution de mobilité adaptée à votre situation : allocation mobilité/véhicule de 400 € via Betterway accompagnée d'une carte de frais professionnels, remboursement à 100 % de votre abonnement aux transports publics ou budget de mobilité douce de 600 € par an
  • Indemnité téléphonique de 30 €
  • Indemnité Internet de 36 €
  • Mutuelle d'entreprise
  • Accès à Wellpass, avec une participation de SumUp, pour vos activités sportives et de bien-être
  • Accès à notre plateforme CE d'avantages salariés
  • Consultations médicales à distance gratuites avec Livi
  • Accès aux services de La Maison Bleue
  • Accompagnement proposé par Action Logement
  • Programme de recommandation interne
  • Des opportunités régulières de formation, d'apprentissage et de développement professionnel

Processus de recrutement

  1. Échange avec un recruteur – Discussion sur votre parcours et vos motivations
  2. Entretien avec le manager – Approfondissement de vos compétences et de votre compréhension du rôle
  3. Mise en situation commerciale – Exercice pratique permettant d'évaluer votre approche de la vente terrain

À propos de SumUp

Chez SumUp, nous soutenons les commerçants du quotidien : artisans, restaurateurs, indépendants et commerces de proximité. Nos solutions leur permettent d'accepter facilement les paiements, de gérer leur activité et de se concentrer sur ce qu'ils font de mieux.

Plus de 3 000 collaborateurs issus de 93 nationalités contribuent aujourd'hui à cette mission. Guidés par nos valeurs — Founder's Mentality, Team First et We Care — nous travaillons ensemble pour simplifier le quotidien des petites entreprises.

SumUp est un employeur garantissant l'égalité des chances. Nous valorisons la diversité des parcours, des expériences et des profils.

Un dernier conseil

Vous avez une expérience en prospection à froid, mais ne cochez pas tous les autres critères ? Postulez quand même.

Votre potentiel, votre motivation, votre capacité à apprendre et votre envie de réussir peuvent faire toute la différence.

Prêt(e) à transformer chaque rencontre en opportunité et à développer votre secteur avec SumUp ? Postulez dès maintenant et venez construire la suite de votre réussite commerciale avec nous.

Job Application Tip

We recognise that candidates feel they need to meet 100% of the job criteria in order to apply for a job. Please note that this is only a guide. If you don't tick every box, it's ok too because it means you have room to learn and develop your career at SumUp.

About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As Technical Writer, you will own the documentation of Alta Ares' product suite — producing the manuals, user guides, interface specifications, and operational references that enable military operators, system integrators, and institutional clients to deploy and use Alta Ares' platforms with confidence.

In defence, documentation is not a nice-to-have. A military operator in a contested environment cannot call the helpdesk. A procurement officer reviewing an acceptance package expects documentation that is precise, complete, and unambiguous. Your work is the last line of clarity between a complex, cutting-edge system and the person who has to operate it under pressure.

You will work closely with Engineering, Product, and the Pre & Post Sales team — translating deeply technical content into structured, accessible, operationally relevant documentation. This is a high-craft, high-ownership role in a company where the quality of your writing directly affects operational outcomes.

Product Documentation — User Guides & Operator Manuals

  • Own the full suite of end-user documentation for Alta Ares' product portfolio: operator manuals, quick-start guides, field reference cards, and system overviews

  • Write clear, structured, and operationally grounded documentation for military end-users — adapting tone, level of detail, and format to the audience (drone operator, system administrator, field commander)

  • Develop and maintain documentation for each product line: ISR module, C-UAS platform, MLOps stack, GCS interface, and ground equipment

  • Produce multilingual documentation in English and French — ensuring accuracy and consistency across both versions

  • Maintain a versioned documentation library aligned with each product release and firmware update

Interface & System Specifications

  • Document software interfaces, system architectures, and hardware integration specifications in collaboration with Engineering

  • Produce interface control documents (ICDs), system description documents (SDDs), and integration guides for system integrators and institutional clients

  • Translate engineering schematics, API references, and architecture diagrams into human-readable specifications accessible to non-specialist audiences

  • Maintain up-to-date configuration guides, parameter references, and software release notes for each product version

  • Support the Engineering team in documenting internal technical standards and development guidelines

Operational & Field Documentation

  • Develop field-ready documentation adapted to operational environments: laminated quick-reference cards, checklists, and compact field guides

  • Produce pre-flight checklists, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting guides for UAV platforms and C-UAS systems

  • Create training materials and operational scenario guides for use during client onboarding, field demonstrations, and exercises

  • Ensure all field documentation meets the usability requirements of military audiences: clear hierarchy, unambiguous language, and actionable step-by-step instructions

Documentation Lifecycle & Quality Management

  • Own the documentation lifecycle end-to-end: planning, drafting, review, validation, versioning, and publication

  • Establish and enforce documentation standards across Alta Ares: style guide, terminology glossary, formatting conventions, and review processes

  • Coordinate review cycles with Engineering, Product, and Pre & Post Sales teams — ensuring technical accuracy before publication

  • Manage the documentation repository in Notion and ensure all documents are findable, versioned, and access-controlled appropriately

  • Track and incorporate feedback from field deployments, client reviews, and post-sales observations into documentation updates

Client-Facing Delivery Documentation

  • Produce documentation packages for client deliverables: acceptance test procedures, delivery dossiers, and contractual documentation requirements

  • Support the preparation of responses to RFP documentation requirements and compliance matrices

  • Contribute to the development of training packages for institutional clients and partner integrators

  • Ensure client-facing documentation meets applicable defence documentation standards and contractual specifications

Candidate Profile - Experience

  • 3–5 years of experience in technical writing — with a strong focus on product documentation, user manuals, or operational guides

  • Prior experience documenting hardware-software integrated systems — mandatory : you must be comfortable with complex, multi-component products

  • Background in defence, aerospace, robotics, deeptech, or dual-use is a strong plus — you understand the operational context in which your documentation will be used

  • Experience producing documentation for non-specialist end-users (operators, field technicians) as well as technical audiences (engineers, integrators)

  • Prior exposure to documentation lifecycle management and versioning in a product environment

We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector, co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

About the job

Mistral is hiring a Head of FDE Learning Programs to build the learning system for one of the company’s fastest-growing organizations. Mistral is scaling its FDE organization from its first hire to several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers within two years. Your mandate is to make capability grow as fast as headcount without lowering the bar for customer work.

You will own:

  • Learning content: Build practical learning across three areas: technical skills, strategic and business capabilities, and product enablement.

  • Onboarding: Build a clear path from a new hire’s first week to independent customer work.

  • Technical bootcamps: Turn new products, research, and field methods into practical training for customer work.

  • Strategic bootcamps: Empower client-facing teams of FDEs to drive business and strategic discussions and to set up for success large partnership programs with customers

  • Program ownership: Own the roadmap, curriculum, contributor model, regional delivery, tools, measurement, and central team.

  • Scaling: Launch useful programs now, then adapt them for larger cohorts without making the content generic or relying on a small group of experts.

  • Team building: Launch the first programs, build a network of instructors, and hire the team needed to support several hundred FDEs.

  • Cross-functional work: Work with functional managers, Product, Engineering, Science, People, GTM Enablement, DevRel, and regional leaders.

  • Readiness standards: Ensure FDEs in every region meet the same standard, can find current material, learn from recent customer work, and understand expectations at the next career level.

  • Knowledge structuration: Ensure internal resources are up to date and pushed to the right stakeholders with a knowledge management approach.

How We Work in Solutions

  • We care about people and outputs.

  • What matters is what you ship, not the time you spend on it

  • Bureaucracy is where urgency goes to vanish. You talk to whoever you need to talk to. The best idea wins, whether it comes from a principal engineer or someone in their first week.

  • Always ask why. The best solutions come from deep understanding, not from copying what worked before

  • We say what we mean. Feedback is direct, timely, and given because we care.

  • No politics. Low ego, high standards.

  • We embrace an unstructured environment and find joy in it.

About you

You have helped build a learning, enablement, or capability function for a technical organization during rapid growth. You can start as the first dedicated owner, deliver useful programs immediately, and build the team and operating model needed to serve several hundred people.

  • You are technically fluent enough to work credibly with AI engineers, Product, and Science, inspect the substance of a program, and challenge material that is unclear or outdated.

  • You have designed programs that work across cohorts, regions, and experience levels without reducing the content to generic training.

  • You can lead work across senior stakeholders, subject-matter experts, managers, and operational partners without relying on reporting lines.

  • You can make firm trade-offs when hiring demand, expert capacity, and program quality compete for attention.

  • You pay attention to the full learner experience, including communications, scheduling, practice, feedback, and manager follow-through.

  • You use evidence to decide which programs to expand, revise, or stop.

  • You communicate clearly with executives, managers, technical experts, and learners.

  • You are fluent in English and can work with teams across regions and time zones.

Ideally, you have

  • Scaled a one-person or small learning function into a team and program that served hundreds of technical employees.

  • Built onboarding that kept pace with rapid hiring in an engineering, FDE, solutions, consulting, or professional-services organization.

  • Designed and operated technical bootcamps or other cohort-based learning programs.

  • Worked in technical DevRel, developer education, or a related role built around demos, code examples, workshops, and practitioner communities.

  • Built role- and level-based curricula connected to skills frameworks or career progression.

  • Managed a global program with contributors and learners across multiple regions.

  • Worked closely with Product, Engineering, Science, People, and customer-facing teams.

  • Designed practical assessments, readiness standards, or certification where appropriate.

  • Used learning platforms, knowledge systems, AI coaches, or program-operations tooling.

  • Worked in AI/ML or another technically complex and fast-changing field.

Why this role matters

Mistral is compressing years of organization growth into two. An FDE organization of several hundred people cannot depend on manager-by-manager onboarding, one-off sessions, and informal access to experts. If learning capacity trails hiring, ramp times would lengthen, standards would diverge, and teams would repeat the same mistakes across regions.

This role will build the programs, teaching network, and systems at the same pace as the organization. Two years from now, success would mean several hundred Deployment Strategists and Applied AI Engineers working from shared standards, learning new capabilities quickly, and improving the system with evidence from customer work.

Mistral is building a sovereign AI cloud for Europe. Our customers in finance, healthcare, and the public sector run frontier models on European-jurisdiction infrastructure, and the Cloud Platform team builds the systems that make that possible — compute orchestration, Kubernetes, bare metal, storage, networking, and the datacenter fleet that runs it all.

European Compute Units let enterprises commit to multi-year capacity on that infrastructure, and we are scaling toward a gigawatt of compute across Europe by 2030. You will design and ship the layer every sovereign AI deployment depends on and shape the team building it.

The Role

This is a people-leadership role from day one. You will manage the team — hiring, coaching, performance, growth paths, honest feedback — while staying close to the code: roughly half your time in architecture decisions and the hardest technical problems the team faces, the other half leading your squad. If you are looking for a senior IC role, this is not it.

AI agents don't run in browsers. They run in sandboxes — and you will lead the team building ours.

We build secure, isolated, network-controlled environments with snapshotting primitives, designed for AI agents and reinforcement-learning workloads. An RL training run doesn't need one environment; it needs thousands, created and destroyed every second. An agent needs to be sandboxed from the world while still feeling fast enough to be useful. That tension — airtight isolation, at fleet scale, at low latency — is the product.

Your customers are the people building the next generation of AI software on our infrastructure; the primitives you ship become the runtime their agents live in.

What You Will Do

  • Build the isolation layer: microVMs or containers, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, snapshot and restore.

  • Own the security boundary. Customers run code they didn't write and can't fully trust — your systems make that safe.

  • Scale to fleets: creation latency, density, and lifecycle management for thousands of concurrent environments.

  • Write Go alongside your team and own the architecture and the hardest implementation decisions.

  • Grow the engineers, not just the software — set the standard for ownership and coach people past their comfort zone.

  • Own people management for the team: hiring, performance, growth paths, and honest feedback.

  • Partner with Product Managers to turn frontier research needs into shippable primitives.

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of real people leadership. You have managed engineers — hired, coached, given honest feedback, and grown them. Hands-on contribution matters here, but this role is judged on the team you build and lead, not just the code you write.

  • Deep Linux internals: namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, virtualization — ideally microVMs of the Firecracker class.

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Not dabbled. Shipped.

  • You understand network isolation at the packet level — not just firewall rules.

  • Performance instincts: you know what a syscall costs, and you have the profiles to prove you've cared.

  • 8+ years building backend or infrastructure systems.

  • You have partnered with product, design, and business teams to ship software that reached real users.

The ones that matter most we write ourselves in Go — S3-compatible object storage, tiering, backup and recovery, caching layers that put cold data on cheap spinning disks.

As the team grows, the balance shifts toward people leadership, and you decide how fast. You will own capacity planning across datacenters and the architecture that keeps data durable when disks, networks, and entire sites fail. Storage is a strategic bet for this org: the team you build and the calls you make will define how a gigawatt of European compute stores its data.

What You Will Do

  • Stand up the storage stack — block, file, object — for training, sandbox, and general compute workloads.

  • Make the build-vs-buy calls: deploy and harden vendor platforms where they win; design and write our own services in Go where they don't.

  • Own the data plane: allocation, duplication, tiering, backup and recovery, S3-compatible APIs.

  • Plan capacity across datacenters and across failure domains — petabytes, not terabytes.

  • Build the team from zero: make the first hires, onboard and coach them, own performance and growth paths, and set the standard for ownership.

  • Partner with Product Managers to shape the storage roadmap and make the technical and business tradeoffs.

What We're Looking For

  • You have shipped production systems in Go. Systems engineers coming from C++ or Rust who are ready to write Go daily should still talk to us.

TL;DR Davis is hiring a Founding Data Engineer to build the data behind our foundation model, trained from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. You will own the data end to end, from raw floorplans and synthetic generation to a canonical representation, curation, large-scale pretraining and the ablations that tell us which data actually moves the model. Here the dataset is part of the algorithm.

About Davis

Davis is an AI-native real estate company accelerating early-stage development and architectural design. Today developers coordinate four to five fragmented stakeholders over weeks or months. Soon they will need only one: Davis.

We turn every input that shapes a development decision into decision-ready outputs: investor-grade feasibility studies, investment analysis, and architect-certified designs, delivered in days. Every stage pairs our proprietary AI systems with expert review, so velocity never comes at the cost of reliability.

We closed a $5.5M pre-seed co-led by Heartcore Capital and Balderton Capital, with Yellow, Evantic and Entrepreneur First, alongside angels from the founding teams of Spacemaker, Black Forest Labs, Hugging Face, Supabase, Cleo and Spore Bio. We already work with leading developers and expect to support hundreds of projects over the coming year, deepening our research, our hiring, and our coverage of the development process end to end.

The Role

You will own the data our foundation model learns from, a model we train from scratch to generate buildings as geometric graphs. Part of the corpus comes from real floorplans as images and PDFs that have to become clean, standardized graphs. A large part will be synthetic, procedurally generated building graphs, geometry and rendered floorplans, with controlled variation in style, scan noise, annotations and furniture, each kept with its ground-truth graph automatically.

You will think about the whole loop, from raw and synthetic data to a canonical structured representation, curation and validation, the training dataset, large-scale pretraining, evaluation, data ablations, and back to improving the generator and the data mixture. You are senior enough to architect the data stack and set the data strategy, and hands-on enough to write the pipelines, run the experiments, train the models and do the ablations yourself.

What you will be working on

  • Corpus from raw sources. Turn real floorplans (images, PDFs, scans) into clean, standardized building graphs, with the geometry and semantics that make them trainable.

  • Synthetic data generation. Explore strategies to expand the dataset with synthetic data.

  • Canonical representation and curation. Define the standardized representation, then filter, deduplicate, quality-score and validate at scale, with versioning, provenance and lineage.

  • Pretraining data and mixtures. Assemble the training datasets, design the mixture and the curriculum, and blend synthetic and real data for large-scale pretraining.

  • Data ablations. Train models to learn which data actually helps, read the results, and feed them back into the generator and the mixture.

  • Evaluation. Build the eval harness (datasets, metrics, regression tests, monitoring) that tracks data and model quality over time.

What We Are Looking For

  • You have built the dataset, not just trained on it. You have personally built or generated the data used for a large pretraining run, from raw or synthetic sources, rather than only training on a dataset someone handed you.

  • Senior and deeply hands-on. At least 5 years of strong experience, senior enough to architect the data stack and set strategy, but still coding the pipelines, running the experiments and doing the ablations yourself.

  • Data as a first-class problem. A track record where the data itself is the object: curation, filtering, deduplication, quality scoring, mixtures, synthetic generation.

  • Strong engineering. Deep Python, clean and typed code, async and concurrency, distributed data pipelines, TDD culture.

Nice to have

  • Computer vision and document understanding, images to structured output, OCR, layout extraction, segmentation, geometry extraction, vectorization, raster to vector, image to scene graph, 3D or CAD.

  • Graph and structured scientific data, molecular, protein or scene graphs, meshes, CAD, BIM, 3D geometry, or relational and structured world data.

  • Synthetic worlds and simulation, a structured state to a simulator to a renderer to synthetic images with perfect labels, then a perception model, with an eye on the sim-to-real gap.

  • Foundation models from scratch, real involvement in a large pretraining run, not only fine-tuning.

  • Public evidence of data ownership, lead on a dataset, a Hugging Face release, a dataset card, a technical blog on your pipeline, or a talk on data curation or synthetic data.

  • GIS and geometry, parcels, zoning layers, projections, computational geometry or constrained optimization.

  • Multi-country data, heterogeneous sources, localization and varying rules.

Why Join Davis

  • Own the data end to end, from the generator to the pretraining mixture, as the person who defines what the model learns from.

  • Shape a foundation model from scratch, on a structured representation no one else is training on.

  • Work on genuinely hard problems, image to graph, synthetic worlds and large-scale pretraining, with your work reaching clients within days.

  • Competitive salary and meaningful equity, at a founding level, in an early-stage company.

  • Join a world-class team, a mix of AI researchers, engineers and architects backed by world-class VCs.

More information about Davis, the team and the market we're going after:

Team

Mehdi (Co-founder & CEO) grew up in a family of architects and has lived this problem firsthand. He is a repeat founder who bootstrapped his first startup at 20, and graduated from Sciences Po and HEC Paris. Amine (Co-founder & CTO) is an AI researcher from École Polytechnique who worked extensively on discrete diffusion and turned down a PhD with Google DeepMind to build Davis. They started working together in July 2025 at Entrepreneur First's first European residency, a two-month lock-in in a German castle.

Today we are a team of twelve: technical profiles from Polytechnique, ENS and INRIA alongside architects and deep real estate expertise. We are small with an extremely high bar. If you want to work deeply on hard problems and see your work reach clients within days, you are the one we need.

Why We Will Win

Real estate is a $13 trillion industry that technology has largely bypassed. The professional services that feed it (design, engineering, feasibility, permitting) represent hundreds of billions in spend that no one has seriously automated.

Proptech spent the last decade selling SaaS on the edges of these workflows. It did not work, for two reasons: no professional wants another tool to learn, and no tool can automate work that runs on expert judgment. Davis makes a different bet. We do not sell tools, we sell the work, AI-generated, expert-validated, delivered in days instead of weeks. Every project compounds our data advantage across typologies, geographies and regulatory contexts.

Why No One Has Solved Architectural Design

Real estate development bleeds time and money in architectural design loops. Architects cycle through dozens of floorplan revisions to meet regulatory and client constraints, each round taking days, each missed constraint restarting the loop. Traditional CAD and BIM tools offer zero generative capability, and parametric tools only check constraints after generation, which leaves designs that frequently break under new zoning rules or irregular sites.

Generative AI has the potential to solve this, but does not yet. Fine-tuning image diffusion models on floorplans produces layouts that look plausible but fall apart under scrutiny: hallucinated rooms, mislabeled spaces, code violations no architect would accept. Pixel-space models have no concept of what a wall is or why a corridor needs to connect two things. Compliance-guidance techniques typically require segmentation at each noisy timestep, compounding errors and making major edits impractical. These layouts may look plausible yet break building codes, or need heavy post-processing before they are usable.

This is exactly the gap Davis closes. Because our model generates on structured representations rather than pixels, it produces compliant, editable plans from the start, and the data you build feeds that model directly.

We care about who you are, not just what's on your CV.

If you are drawn to what we are building but do not meet every requirement, we still want to hear from you. Studies show that women in particular tend to apply only when they meet all of the criteria. If that is you, please do not let it hold you back. We would love to receive your application.

Configuration de la plateforme et données (environ 50 %)

  • Configurer la plateforme InsideBoard via son interface d'administration ou ses API : KPIs (formules, agrégation, fréquences), plans d'action et programmes de coaching, challenges, guidance, sections de profil, champs personnalisés, formulaires, notifications, imports d'utilisateurs, de départements et de tags.

 L’Institut Mines-Télécom fédère les grandes écoles françaises autour des défis industriels majeurs, numériques, énergétiques et écologiques. Pensés comme de véritables hubs d’innovation, nos cinq Centres de Formation et de Recherche  articulent leurs expertises autour de grands enjeux industriels, environnementaux, sociétaux et technologiques.

Leur mission ? Imaginer le monde de demain en alliant excellence académique et impact concret.

Vous rêvez d’une industrie propre, efficace et durable ? Le centre SPIN en fait sa priorité.

Énergie, environnement, procédés industriels… on y conçoit des systèmes pour produire mieux, avec moins.

L’objectif ? Limiter l’impact environnemental, réduire la consommation énergétique et booster l’efficacité.

🔧 Dans un monde en pleine mutation, nos équipes déploient leur créativité scientifique pour accompagner l’industrie du futur. 

Et vous, prêt·e à innover à nos côtés ?

🎯 Ce que nous attendons de vous

En tant que chercheur postdoctoal, vous êtes au cœur de nos missions en recherche et innovation affecté au centre SPIN. Au sein de ce centre vous conjuguez curiosité scientifique avec un intérêt pour l’articulation entre problématiques de recherche fondamentale et problématiques indus-trielles.

Le centre SPIN est l’un des centres de recherche de Mines Saint-Etienne dédié à la recherche en génie des procédés et rassemble environ 80 personnes comprenant enseignants-chercheurs, postdocs, doctorants, stagiaires, et profite du soutien de personnels administratifs et techniques. L’activité du centre SPIN s’inscrit dans le périmètre du Laboratoire Georges Friedel (UMR 5307) et du Laboratoire Environnement Ville et Société (UMR 5600). Vous développerez votre activité de recherche au sein du département « Procédés de Manipulation de la Matière Granulaire » (PMMG) qui concentre divers expertises scientifiques sur les procédés de transformation et la caractérisa-tion de matériaux granulaires à partir d’approches expérimentales et numériques, ainsi qu’à travers différents champs disciplinaires allant de la géométrie mathématique à la chimie minérale en pas-sant par la physique des écoulements complexes. L’activité du centre SPIN, comme du départe-ment PMMG, est caractérisée par une forte interdisciplinarité ainsi que par de nombreuses collabo-rations avec d’autres institutions de recherche et d’enseignement en Europe et dans le monde, et profite de nombreux contrats avec des partenaires industriels.

La matière granulaire est un état de la matière particulier qui peine à être décrit par les lois de com-portement qui s’appliquent habituellement aux fluides, ou aux solides. Cependant une vaste majo-rité des matières premières transformées dans de nombreux secteurs industriels, ou des produits manufacturés, se présentent sous la forme de particules solides (grains de poudre, agglomérats, granulés, comprimés, etc..). La complexité de la dynamique de ces solides divisés émerge du grand nombre de particules solides concernées. En particulier dans le cas de particules solides transpor-tées dans une conduite de transport pneumatique, où l’écoulement d’un gaz le long d’une con-duite entraine les particules solides, les interactions avec les parois solides sont le siège de nom-breux procédés physico-chimiques. Au-delà des collisions élastiques qui entraînent le rebond de la majorité des particules solides sur les parois, des processus de fragmentation, d’arrachement de charges, d’échauffement local, etc. sont susceptibles de provoquer des transformations de la ma-tière transportée. Dans certains cas, la formation de dépôts sur les parois peut être observée et affecte négativement les performances du procédé de transport.

Le travail attendu sera de mettre en place un montage expérimental capable d’étudier les proces-sus responsables de la formation de ces enrochements à partir de mesures de pression, de débit, de charges électrostatiques, d’observation par microscopie, de caractérisation granulométrique etc. Différentes poudres modèles pourront être utilisées afin de reproduire les observations d’enrochement reportées dans la litérature. L’équipe d’encadrement sera constituée d’enseignants-chercheurs du centre SPIN ainsi que d’ingénieurs R&D de notre partenaire industriel ORANO.

ou d’un diplôme d’ingénieur

🌍 Pourquoi rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne ?

Nous accompagnons chacun de nos collaborateurs sur le chemin de l’excellence, avec la conviction qu’ensemble, nous pouvons avoir un impact durable et significatif sur notre monde.

Rejoindre Mines Saint-Étienne, c’est l’opportunité de trouver :

data.description:
Context:

This postdoctoral position is part of the European project TAKE-OFF (Clean Aviation programme), which is preparing the full-scale flight demonstration of Safran Aircraft Engines’ RISE Open Fan engine on the Airbus A380 flying testbed, with the aim of reducing fuel consumption by 30 % and entering service around 2035. Without a nacelle, the engine noise sources radiate directly into free field. LMFA (École Centrale de Lyon), in collaboration with LVA (INSA Lyon), is in charge of analysing the near-field pressure data acquired in flight by microphones installed on the fuselage, in order to reconstruct the engine noise sources.

Objective:

To extend the modal analysis methods developed at LMFA for ducted engines [1] to unducted fans. For the first time, modal analysis will be applied to microphones located in an unconfined medium and to modes radiating under free-field conditions, and design criteria specific to this configuration will be established (spatial sampling, resolution, array-to-rotor distance relative to the array size).

Description:

Task 1 – Model and inverse problem. Build a set of eigenfunctions describing the radiation of an unducted rotor-stator stage (spinning modes weighted by Bessel functions [2], spherical harmonics, etc.) and embed it in a Bayesian inverse approach [1] to estimate the modal amplitudes of tonal and broadband components. Flow and fuselage effects may be accounted for through CAA computations.

Task 2 – Validation on the MAMBO database. The developments will be tested on an unducted propeller + stator configuration recently studied at LMFA (MAMBO project), instrumented with three arrays: a half-cylindrical array, a planar array on the side (representative of fuselage instrumentation) and a motorised arc array measuring directivity, which will serve as an independent reference. This study will assess the robustness of the method and define array design criteria.

Task 3 – Application to flight tests. The methodology will be applied to the near-field pressure data acquired on the fuselage during the TAKE-OFF flight test campaigns, in order to identify the modal content of the noise radiated by the Open Fan engine and to infer information on its generation mechanisms.

Starting date : 01/01/2027


Profile and application:

PhD in acoustics, aeroacoustics or signal processing; skills in array methods, inverse problems and/or modal analysis; scientific programming (Python/Matlab).

References:

[1] Pereira, A. & Jacob, M.C., 2022, Modal analysis of in-duct fan broadband noise via an iterative Bayesian inverse approach, J. Sound Vib., doi:10.1016/j.jsv.2021.116633.

[2] Roger, M. & Kucukcoskun, K., 2019, Near-and-far field modeling of advanced tail-rotor noise using source-mode expansions, J. Sound Vib., 453, 328-354.

LMFA contacts: Antonio Pereira, Marc Jacob

LVA contact: Quentin Leclère (LVA, INSA Lyon)

Funding: European project TAKE-OFF (Technology and Knowledge for European Open Fan Flight)

You will contribute to protocol development, medical data review, study documentation, and cross-functional collaboration to ensure high-quality clinical trial delivery in compliance with regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Support and represent the Study Medical Manager throughout the clinical study lifecycle.
  • Contribute to the development and review of key clinical documents, including protocols, protocol amendments, informed consent forms (ICFs), CRFs, and medical data validation plans.
  • Perform medical review of patient data, listings, narratives, CIOMs, and clinical cases.
  • Collaborate closely with Clinical Operations, Pharmacovigilance, Biostatistics, and Data Management teams to support data review and consistency checks.
  • Review study-related documentation and contribute to interim analyses, Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), publications, and statistical outputs.
  • Support the preparation and management of study committees, investigator meetings, and study training activities.
  • Maintain medical and scientific documentation within the Trial Master File (TMF).
  • Draft responses to medical questions from Health Authorities, Ethics Committees, investigators, and study teams.
  • Develop medical review guidelines and support outsourced medical review activities when applicable.
  • Contribute to audit and inspection readiness activities and support responses to findings.

Requirements

  • Advanced degree in Medicine (MD), Pharmacy (PharmD), Life Sciences, or related scientific discipline.
  • Strong experience as a Clinical Scientist, Medical Scientist, Clinical Research Physician, or similar role.
  • Experience supporting clinical studies in Immunology & Inflammation and/or Oncology.
  • Strong understanding of clinical development, study design, and clinical trial conduct.
  • Knowledge of ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements, and clinical research processes.
  • Experience reviewing clinical data, patient profiles, narratives, and safety information.
  • Familiarity with Clinical Study Reports (CSRs), protocols, and TMF documentation.
  • Strong cross-functional collaboration and communication skills.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

Benefits

Why join us?

At Excelya, we combine a passion for science with the enthusiasm of teamwork to redefine excellence in healthcare.

Here's what makes us unique:

We are a young and ambitious healthcare company, bringing together 900 Excelyates, driven by the goal of becoming the leading mid-sized CRO in Europe, while offering the best employee experience.

Our "one-stop provider" service model—combining full-service, functional service provider, and consulting—allows you to grow through diverse and stimulating projects. By collaborating with leading experts, you will contribute to the development of scientific, operational, and human knowledge, all in service of improving the patient journey.

Excelling with kindness means evolving in an environment that values ​​your natural talents, encourages boldness, pushes boundaries, and cultivates your potential, so that you can fully contribute to our shared mission.

data.description:
Du denkst in Prozessen und Datenflüssen, erkennst schnell, wo Abläufe haken, und hast Freude daran, manuelle Arbeit durch saubere Automatisierungen zu ersetzen? Dann suchen wir dich zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als Business Development Manager / Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d).

In dieser Rolle systematisierst du unsere Abläufe, verbindest unsere Systeme miteinander und setzt eigenverantwortlich Digitalisierungsprojekte um – intern und bei unseren Kunden. Gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung arbeitest du an der Zukunft der asensu GmbH und treibst unser Wachstum voran.

Was macht die asensu GmbH?

Die asensu GmbH ist eine spezialisierte Marketingagentur, die mittelständische Unternehmen dabei unterstützt, online sichtbarer zu werden und planbar neue Kunden sowie qualifizierte Mitarbeiter zu gewinnen. Unser Schwerpunkt liegt insbesondere auf Unternehmen aus dem Küchen- und Möbelhandel sowie dem Handwerk.

Neben Werbekampagnen sorgen wir durch Prozessoptimierung und Automatisierung dafür, dass unsere Kunden höhere Margen erzielen. Rund 100 Unternehmen in ganz Deutschland vertrauen dabei auf uns. Damit wir weiter so wachsen können, brauchen wir exzellente Abläufe – und genau dafür suchen wir dich.

Was sind Deine Aufgaben als Business Development Manager / Wirtschaftsinformatiker (m/w/d)?

Du verschaffst dir einen Überblick über alle Geschäftsprozesse – von Vertrieb über Kundenbetreuung und Kampagnenumsetzung bis zur Verwaltung. Du erkennst Verbesserungspotenziale, übersetzt sie in technische Lösungen und setzt diese gemeinsam mit den jeweiligen Teams um. Dazu gehören Automatisierungen zwischen CRM, Buchhaltung, Kommunikationskanälen und Datenbanken, die Anbindung von Schnittstellen sowie Dashboards, mit denen Geschäftsführung und Teams ihre Kennzahlen im Blick behalten.

Neue Abläufe dokumentierst du so, dass jeder im Team sie sicher anwenden kann: als Prozessbeschreibung, Checkliste oder Schulungsvideo auf unserer digitalen Schulungsplattform. So legst du die Grundlage dafür, dass neue Kolleginnen und Kollegen schnell einsteigen und wir als Unternehmen sauber skalieren.

Aufgabenbereiche (nach gründlicher Einarbeitung):

  • Geschäftsprozesse etablieren: Du führst neue Abläufe und Standards im Unternehmen ein und legst damit die Weichen für unser Wachstum

  • Prozessverbesserung: Du analysierst bestehende Abläufe, erkennst Engpässe und optimierst unsere internen Prozesse

  • Automatisierung: Du baust und betreust Workflows und Integrationen (z. B. mit n8n, Airtable und API-Schnittstellen)

  • Daten & Kennzahlen: Du baust Datenstrukturen und Dashboards auf und bereitest Kennzahlen für die Geschäftsführung auf

  • Projekte leiten: Du begleitest die Einführung neuer Tools und IT-Systeme und leitest interne Projekte von der Planung bis zum Livegang

  • Kundenprojekte: Du setzt Prozessoptimierungen und Automatisierungen auch für unsere Kunden um

  • Schulungen: Du dokumentierst deine Lösungen und erstellst Schulungsmaterialien für unsere interne Schulungsplattform

  • Schnittstelle: Du arbeitest eng mit Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing und Kundenbetreuung zusammen

Gehalt: 4.200 Euro pro Monat (brutto)
Weiterentwicklungs- und Aufstiegsmöglichkeiten in den nächsten Jahren sind vorhanden.
Die Einarbeitungsphase dauert in der Regel 2–4 Monate.

Wir bieten:

  • Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Wir möchten, dass jede Person in unserem Team langfristig mit uns arbeitet. Daher übernehmen 95 % unserer Mitarbeiter dauerhaft ins Unternehmen.

  • Attraktive Vergütung & Karrierechancen: Unsere Mitarbeiter erhalten ein attraktives Gehalt sowie Aufstiegs- und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Wir sind stetig am Wachsen, daher benötigen wir in Zukunft weitere Experten und/oder Führungskräfte.

  • Echter Gestaltungsspielraum: Du arbeitest direkt mit der Geschäftsführung und siehst unmittelbar, wie deine Prozesse und Automatisierungen das Unternehmen voranbringen.

  • Klare, strukturierte Einarbeitung: Du durchläufst eine klare und strukturierte Einarbeitungsphase mit festen Abläufen und Prozessen. Über unsere digitale Schulungsplattform hast du jederzeit Zugriff auf Videos, Schritt-für-Schritt-Anleitungen und Checklisten.

  • Mobilitätsbudget & Betriebsrente: Wir unterstützen dich mit einem Mobilitätsbudget für deinen Weg zur Arbeit und einem hohen Zuschuss zur Betriebsrente.

  • Modernes Office: Unser modernes Office befindet sich unmittelbar in der Nähe vom Lietzensee in Berlin-Charlottenburg – mit Dachterrasse und Loungeecke.

  • Hochwertiges Equipment: Wir arbeiten mit hochwertigem Arbeitsequipment wie höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen, Doppelmonitoren und Apple-Geräten.



Das bist du:

  • Abgeschlossenes Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Wirtschaftsinformatik, BWL, Business Administration oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang

  • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in Business Development, Prozessdigitalisierung, Automatisierung oder IT-Projekten

  • Praktische Erfahrung im Projektmanagement

  • Erfahrung mit No-Code-/Low-Code-Tools (z. B. n8n, Make, Zapier, Airtable) sowie mit APIs und Webhooks; Grundkenntnisse in JavaScript oder SQL sind ein Plus

  • Die Fähigkeit, bestehende Prozesse nachzuvollziehen, effizient umzusetzen und gezielt zu verbessern

  • Ausgeprägte analytische Fähigkeiten und hohe Präzision

  • Strukturierte, selbstständige und zuverlässige Arbeitsweise

  • Starke kommunikative Fähigkeiten – du erklärst Technik so, dass jeder sie versteht

  • Schnelle Auffassungsgabe und hohe Disziplin

  • Belastbarkeit und guter Umgang mit Leistungsdruck

Visium combines strategy, frontier AI, and deep regulated-industry expertise to build and deploy AI-native systems that reinvent how businesses operate - unlocking the value of AI at scale.

We're not a strategy firm that ships slide decks and walks away. Not a tech consultancy that builds what won't get adopted. Not a product company chasing problems it doesn't understand. We're all three at once: strategy, deep technical and integration expertise, and product, working as one. That combination is our flywheel. Consulting keeps us close to the hardest real-world problems. Products let us solve them at scale. Every engagement sharpens our products; every deployment makes the next engagement faster, deeper, and more certain.

We're obsessed with outcomes. While 95% of enterprise AI pilots never reach production, Visium is built to be the 5% delivering productised AI that compounds in value, not point solutions that deliver marginal gains. We are AI-native, not AI-adjacent. We don't bolt AI onto broken workflows; we redesign them with AI at the core.

Role

As a Senior AI Strategist (German Speaker), you are the bridge between technical teams and business stakeholders, helping the organization turn AI opportunities into successful, sustainable solutions. You will operate at the intersection of change management, stakeholder management, and AI delivery. Your role is to create alignment, bring structure to ambiguity, manage expectations, and ensure that teams and stakeholders move together towards the desired outcome.

You will work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Data Engineers, Business stakeholders, IT, and senior leadership. While you won’t be expected to write code, you should be technically fluent enough to understand AI projects, challenge assumptions, explain trade-offs, and translate technical topics into clear business implications.

  • Drive change management initiatives related to the adoption of AI and new ways of working
  • Act as the key interface between technical teams, business stakeholders, and leadership
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders and create alignment across different interests and priorities
  • Translate business needs into clear objectives, requirements, and actionable plans
  • Communicate complex technical topics in a clear, concise, and compelling way to both technical and non-technical audiences
  • Facilitate discussions, manage expectations, and navigate challenging stakeholder situations
  • Identify resistance, risks, dependencies, and potential blockers early and proactively address them
  • Create structure and momentum in ambiguous or fast-paced environments
  • Coordinate delivery across cross-functional teams and ensure consistent progress towards agreed outcomes
  • Ensure that AI solutions are aligned with business needs, adoption requirements, and long-term value
  • Support teams and stakeholders throughout the transition from PoC to MVP and production

Requirements

To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of expertise, experience, and skills including:

  • 6+ years in project/product management or change management + 4+ years working with AI/data/technology.
  • Solid understanding of AI, data, and the AI lifecycle; technically fluent enough to challenge decisions and understand trade-offs.
  • Experience driving technology, process, or organizational change and supporting adoption.
  • Strong ability to manage and influence senior stakeholders, navigate conflicting priorities, and build alignment.
  • Excellent communication skills; able to simplify complex topics and communicate confidently with technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Experience managing complex projects, timelines, risks, dependencies, and multiple stakeholders.
  • Fluent in English and German.

Benefits

What we offer

  • A competitive compensation package
  • A yearly education budget to steep your learning curve
  • A yearly sport budget because a fit body leads to a fit mind
  • A flexible working culture because your work-life balance matters to us
  • A position that enables you to have an impact on 1’000s of people, and the whole company's growth.
  • An international, knowledgeable, and passionate team with a strong collaborative mindset

Check our LinkedIn and website to learn more about us & don’t hesitate to contact us if you have any questions.

Über uns

MEONDI ist Unternehmenspartner für Digitalisierung und neue Arbeitsstrukturen. Wir navigieren unsere Kunden ganzheitlich durch Innovations- und Transformationsprozesse sowie agile Produktentwicklungen.
Mit MEONDI Frontier Services beschäftigen wir uns gezielt mit neuen Technologien und den Möglichkeiten, die daraus für Unternehmen entstehen. Wir beraten unsere Kunden dabei nicht nur, sondern entwickeln gemeinsam mit ihnen neue Konzepte, validieren diese früh und setzen daraus konkrete digitale Produkte und Lösungen um.
Unser Anspruch ist es, neue technologische Möglichkeiten früh zu verstehen, sinnvoll auf reale Probleme zu übertragen und daraus Lösungen zu entwickeln, die tatsächlich im Alltag funktionieren.
Du willst nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten, sondern Verantwortung dafür übernehmen, dass aus einer Produktidee ein belastbares Softwareprodukt wird?
Als Lead Product Engineer bist du ein zentraler Teil von MEONDI Frontier Services und gestaltest mit uns, wie wir neue Produkte technisch denken und umsetzen. Du bringst die technische Perspektive von Anfang an in wichtige Entscheidungen ein und übernimmst Verantwortung für die Konsequenzen dieser Entscheidungen.
Dabei arbeitest du nicht in einer fertig definierten Rolle mit klar abgegrenzten Aufgaben. Du gestaltest die technische Seite unseres Produktgeschäfts aktiv mit, setzt Standards, triffst Architekturentscheidungen und baust selbst mit. Wenn wir mit unseren Produkten erfolgreich skalieren, wächst auch dein Verantwortungsbereich mit.
Du verbindest fundiertes Software Engineering mit einem praktischen Verständnis für AI-Produkte und agentische Systeme. Du weißt, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt werden kann, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen, skalierbaren und wirtschaftlich tragfähigen Produkten zusammenkommt.

Zusätzliche Reisebereitschaft ist erforderlich und richtet sich nach dem jeweiligen Kundenprojekt. Je nach Projekt arbeitest du regelmäßig und möglicherweise mehrere Tage pro Woche vor Ort beim Kunden. Remote-Arbeit ist grundsätzlich möglich, sofern die jeweiligen Projekt- und Kundenanforderungen dies zulassen. Darüber hinaus solltest du bereit sein, regelmäßig bei MEONDI, insbesondere im Raum Stuttgart, präsent zu sein und an internen MEONDI-Events sowie Community-Treffen teilzunehmen.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt:

Lead Product Engineer (a)


Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Machbarkeit bewerten: Opportunities früh hinsichtlich Architektur, Risiken, Aufwand und Umsetzbarkeit einschätzen.
  • Technische Verantwortung übernehmen: Produktspezifikationen in tragfähige technische Lösungen übersetzen und zentrale Architekturentscheidungen treffen.
  • Hands-on Software entwickeln: Produktive Software selbst bauen – vom Frontend über Backend und Datenhaltung bis zu Schnittstellen und Betrieb.
  • Produktionsreife sicherstellen: Stabilität, Skalierbarkeit, Security, DevOps, Observability, Wartbarkeit und Betrieb von Anfang an berücksichtigen.
  • Prototypen in Produkte überführen: Schnelle Validierungen technisch einordnen und daraus belastbare, langfristig tragfähige Systeme entwickeln.
  • AI-native Softwaresysteme entwickeln: Verstehen, wo AI sinnvoll eingesetzt wird, wo klassische Softwarelogik notwendig bleibt und wie beides zu stabilen Produkten zusammenkommt.
  • AI-gestützte Softwareentwicklung weiterentwickeln: Moderne Coding Agents und neue Engineering-Ansätze praktisch einsetzen, kritisch bewerten und sinnvoll in die Entwicklungsarbeit integrieren.
  • Engineering-Standards prägen: Architekturprinzipien, Tooling, Entwicklungsprozesse und Qualitätsstandards für Frontier Services mit aufbauen.


Das bringst du mit

  • Du hast einen belastbaren Track Record mit produktiv eingesetzter Software.
  • Du hast bereits Verantwortung für Software übernommen und kennst die Anforderungen, die daraus im echten Betrieb entstehen.
  • Du hast Erfahrung in einem Produktumfeld oder einer vergleichbaren Situation mit echtem Skin in the Game für Qualität, Nutzen und Betrieb der Software.
  • Du kannst offene und unvollständig definierte Probleme selbstständig strukturieren, Lösungswege entwickeln und die richtigen nächsten Schritte bestimmen.
  • Du kannst dich nicht hinter großen Teams oder eng geschnittenen Tickets verstecken, sondern übernimmst Ownership für das Ergebnis.
  • Du besitzt ein starkes Full-Stack-Verständnis und kannst vollständige Anwendungen eigenständig entwickeln.
  • Du beherrschst die Grundlagen moderner Softwareentwicklung sicher – von Datenbanken, APIs und Architektur bis zu Testing, Cloud, Deployment, Security und Betrieb.
  • Du hast praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs, AI-Agenten und AI-basierten Anwendungen und verstehst, wie diese mit klassischer Softwarelogik zusammenspielen.
  • Du nutzt Coding Agents und AI-gestützte Entwicklungswerkzeuge produktiv und kannst deren Möglichkeiten und Grenzen realistisch einschätzen.
  • Du verbindest hohe Qualitätsansprüche mit Pragmatismus. Du vermeidest sowohl Overengineering als auch kurzfristige Lösungen, deren Konsequenzen später andere tragen müssen.
  • Du arbeitest gerne hands-on und validierst technische Entscheidungen im Code und in realen Systemen.
  • Englisch: sehr gute, verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse.
  • Deutsch: ein klarer Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung.
Kein bestimmter Abschluss erforderlich. Entscheidend sind technisches Urteilsvermögen, praktische Erfahrung und die Fähigkeit, produktive Software ganzheitlich zu entwickeln. Ein technisches Studium kann hilfreich sein, ist aber keine Voraussetzung.

Agora Industry

Are you passionate about biomass feedstocks as a means to decarbonise heavy industry applications? Do you bring expertise in the technical, economic and climate policy aspects of biomass availability, processing and use? Are you excited to work in a diverse, multi-disciplinary and international team? Then, this is the perfect opportunity for you!
Reaching a climate-neutral industry will require unprecedented investments in a wide range of GHG mitigation technologies, due to the sector’s inherent complexity and regional diversity. While a significant share of emissions can be reduced by advancing energy efficiency and expanding direct electrification powered by renewable energy, there is also the need for more complex and costly measures as well as alternative feedstocks for processes, where biomass and hydrogen technologies can be implemented. To tap into this potential, climate-effective biomass uses in industry require thorough understanding of availability and costs across different regions to give recommendations on policies that help to decarbonise industry in a competitive way, incorporating ecological sustainability boundaries.  Under the umbrella of the Agora Think Tanks, Agora Industry develops politically feasible and science-based strategies and solutions for the transformation to climate neutrality – in Germany, Europe, and internationally. As a think tank and policy lab we facilitate a productive exchange of ideas amongst stakeholders from politics, business, science and civil society. As a non-partisan, non-profit organisation funded by foundations and public institutions, we are independent of corporate and partisan interests. Our exclusive mission is to serve the climate and the common good.To strengthen our team, we are looking for a
 
Project Manager or Project Officer Biomass Value Chains (f/m/d)
Full- or part-time (min. 32 hours)– based in Berlin 
 
You will work on the supply side of biomass as a feedstock for hard-to-electrify applications in industry. The geographical scope will be global, covering different conditions and contexts that vary across geographies. This position is part of Agora Industry’s central Technologies & Analysis team, working closely with regional teams.


Your responsibilities include

  • Contributing to the development and implementation of international projects focused on climate-effective biomass solutions for industrial decarbonisation, encompassing farm- and forest-level availability, logistics and conversion technologies, as well as biomass supply for industrial carbon dioxide removal (CDR).
  • Analysing biomass supply costs, availability and potentials for different agriculture and forestry products across multiple geographies, taking into account competing uses in different sectors and market implications. 
  • Conducting and coordinating projects on biomass for industrial applications and related technological enablers and policy support mechanisms
  • Analysing policy and regulatory gaps that hinder biomass use in various regions with a focus on economic, regulatory, and governance frameworks.  
  • Monitoring the development of technology and business models related to the scaling, mobilization and system integration of biomass value chains and logistics. 
  • Supporting stakeholder engagement with policymakers, industry, civil society, funders, among others, to inform discussions around biomass applications across different industry sectors.
  • Pro-actively contributing to building partnerships and working closely with network partners across the globe. 
  • Liaising with expert colleagues across the Agora Think Tanks (including Agora Agriculture) to facilitate their contributions to projects and knowledge sharing across different regions.
  • Actively contributing to internal discussions.
  • Managing subcontractors including preparing agreements and work plans, supervising and guiding project progress, and managing the quality of deliverables.
  • As Project Officer, the focus is on contributing to the technical management of specific projects with smaller budget, largely independent research, contributing to the conceptualisation and development of complex topics, and of project-related reporting and communication. 
  • As Project Manager, the focus is on technical management and responsibility for specific projects with smaller budgets, independent comprehensive research, conceptualisation and development of complex topics, technical supervision of students and interns, and project-related reporting and communication.


We are looking for

  • A Master’s degree in energy, environmental engineering or forestry/agriculture engineering, natural sciences, renewable energies, agricultural economist, or similar 
  • As Project Officer: Preferably 2 years of experience (including internships, student work or post-graduate roles) in the field of quantitative analysis of biomass systems.
  • As Project Manager: At least 4 years of overall professional experience, with 2 years specifically in the field of biomass
  • A proven track record and expertise in biomass supply cost, transport logistics and conversion technologies. 
  • Solid knowledge of the farming and forestry sectors.
  • Familiarity with agricultural systems and ideally forest systems in different world regions is a plus. 
  • Good background understanding of industrial transformation is a plus.
  • Experience with Life-Cycle Assessment is a plus. 
  • Familiarity with sustainable biomass certification and deforestation-free frameworks is a plus.
  • Strong networking skills and the ability to engage with business, industry associations, research partners and policy makers.
  • A creative and result-oriented mind, capable of developing new ideas and proposals with a view to having impact.
  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written; track-record in writing high quality documents.
  • Full command of the English language in reading and writing, knowledge of other languages is a plus.
  • Willingness to travel outside Europe. 

 We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why you are the right person for the job.


What we offer

  • An opportunity to work in a mission-driven, highly motivated, and professional international team.
  • Opportunities for professional growth and advancement; including access to a mental well-being platform.
  • Flexible working hours and a hybrid work environment, with access to an attractive office space in central Berlin and a good setup to work from home.
  • Weekly breakfast, team events and other get-togethers with colleagues from around the globe.
  • One option from our benefit basket (e.g. job ticket, shopping vouchers, Urban Sports, etc.).
  • Opportunities for professional and personal development and advancement.
  • Entitlement of 29 paid leave days per year (5-days working week); 24th & 31st December off-work.
  • A cooperative working atmosphere with flat communication and decision-making hierarchies.
  • Assistance with visa and work permits for international candidates if required.
  • A structured onboarding programme and regular team and organisation-wide retreats to bring us all together; and 
  • A full or part-time role, initially limited to two years.


How to apply

We assume that there are excellent candidates for the job who do not meet all the criteria in the description. Maybe you have certain skills we haven’t thought of yet? Tell us why
 you are the right person for the job.
We look forward to receiving your application by 30th of September 2026 via our website.
For reasons of objectivity, we ask that you refrain from submitting an application
 photo.
We want an energy transition for everyone from everyone. Therefore, we are particularly
 pleased to receive applications from people from groups that have been underrepresented
 in energy and industrial policy. We welcome applications regardless of gender and gender identity,
 nationality, ethnic origin, religion or belief, disability and age, and sexual orientation. Our
 offices are not completely barrier-free, but we are open to find individual solutions.

Unsere Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeiter sind der Schlüssel unseres Erfolgs. Seit über 100 Jahren stehen wir für innovative Produkte und höchste Qualität – möglich durch unser Team, das mit Mut, Ehrgeiz und dem Willen zur Weiterentwicklung jeden Tag neue Maßstäbe setzt. Von unserem Standort in Ebersbach aus, an dem rund 200 Mitarbeitende beschäftigt sind, vertreiben wir leistungsstarke Gewerbesauger, Kehrmaschinen und hochwertige Sanitärprodukte. Bei uns trägst du Verantwortung, gestaltest aktiv mit und wächst an deinen Aufgaben. Offenheit, Vertrauen und gegenseitige Unterstützung prägen unser Miteinander. Hier findest du keine Arbeitstage wie im Hamsterrad, sondern Raum für Ideen und echte Entwicklung. Werde auch du ein Teil unserer Gemeinschaft und gestalte mit uns gemeinsam die Zukunft. Wir freuen uns auf dich!

Aufgaben

Das kannst du erwarten

  • Betreuung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Social-Media-Kanäle -
    insbesondere Instagram, LinkedIn und YouTube – mit kreativen Content
    Ideen, Kampagnen und wiederkehrenden Formaten
  • Planung und Steuerung des Content- und Redaktionsplans inkl.
    Erstellung und Veröffentlichung der Beiträge
  • Eigenständige Erstellung von Social-Media-Content sowie Briefing und
    Koordination von Foto- und Videocontent mit unserem internen Team
  • Aktive Betreuung unserer Community und Steuerung von Influenzer-
    Kooperationen
  • Erkennen relevanter Trends und Entwicklung passender Ansätze für
    unsere Marke und Zielgruppen
  • Planung und Steuerung von Paid-Social-Kampagnen – von
    Markenbekanntheit und Reichweite bis hin zu Leads und Conversions
  • Analyse der Kanal- und Kampagnenperformance sowie Ableitung
    konkreter Optimierungsmaßnahmen

Qualifikation

Das macht dich aus

  • Ausbildung oder Studium im Bereich Marketing, Kommunikation, Medien
    oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation – entscheidend ist für uns vor allem
    deine praktische Erfahrung im Social Media Marketing
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis von Instagram und dem Meta-Ökosystem sowie
    Erfahrung mit LinkedIn und YouTube
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Paid Social und dem Meta Ads Manager – von der
    Kampagnenplanung und -steuerung bis zur Analyse und Optimierung
  • Sicheres Verständnis relevanter KPIs und dafür, wie Content und
    Kampagnen zu Reichweite, Traffic, Leads und Verkäufen beitragen
  • Gutes Gespür für Marken, Zielgruppen , guten Content und aktuelle
    Trends
  • Erfahrung mit gängigen Video- und Bildbearbeitungsprogrammen, z. B.
    Adobe Premiere und Photoshop , CapCut, Canva
  • Kreativität, Eigeninitiative sowie selbstständiges, strukturiertes Arbeiten

Benefits

Das bieten wir dir

  • Flexibles und mobiles Arbeiten
  • Attraktive Vergütung
  • Hochmodernes Arbeitsumfeld
  • Individuelle Weiterentwicklung
  • Großartiges und motiviertes Team
  • Betriebliches Gesundheitsmanagement
  • Firmen-Fitness
  • Work-Life-Balance
  • Corporate Benefits
  • Krankenzusatzversicherung
  • Fahrrad-Leasing
  • Sonderurlaubstage nach Betriebszugehörigkeit
  • Starmix-Bezahlkarte
  • Kostenlose Getränke

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung!

JEWLIF – Jüdisches Leben in Europa e. V. mit Sitz in Köln stärkt jüdisches Leben in Deutschland und Europa durch Projekte in Bildung, Wissenschaft, Kunst, Kultur und Medienkompetenz. Für Oktober bis Dezember 2026 suchen wir eine erfahrene selbstständige Fachkraft für Presse, PR und Kommunikation für projektbezogene Aufträge.

Aufgaben

Je nach Anlass vereinbaren wir mit dir einzelne Leistungspakete:

· Pressemitteilungen: Recherche, Texterstellung und Überarbeitung nach Briefing, mit Zitat des Generalsekretärs, Boilerplate und Förderhinweis sowie bis zu zwei Korrekturrunden, einschließlich einer Fassung für unsere Website. Bei Bedarf ergänzt um die Ansprache ausgewählter Redaktionen und einen kurzen Resonanzbericht.

· Pressemappen: Aufbereitung von Informationen zu JEWLIF und einzelnen Maßnahmen mit Factsheets, Hintergrundtexten, FAQ und Bildmaterial. mit geklärten Bildrechten.

· Newsletter: Sammeln von Informationen aus unseren Projekten, Redigieren der Texte sowie Auswahl und Bearbeitung passender Bilder mit geklärten Nutzungsrechten. Du setzt jede Ausgabe vollständig in unserer bestehenden Brevo-Vorlage auf und bereitest sie zur Freigabe vor.

· Social Media: Entwicklung von Redaktionsplänen sowie Text und Gestaltung einer vereinbarten Anzahl von Beiträgen, bei Bedarf einschließlich Veröffentlichung.

· Presseanfragen und Veranstaltungen: Recherche und Antwortentwürfe zu einzelnen Anfragen mit Dokumentation in einem Anfrageprotokoll sowie Vorbereitung konkreter Pressetermine mit Einladung, Ablauf, Sprechzettel und Hintergrundinformationen.

· Dokumentation: Erstellung kurzer Checklisten für Presseabläufe (Pressemitteilung, Pressetermin, Presseanfrage und Erstreaktion bei kritischer Berichterstattung) und geordnete Übergabe der erarbeiteten Materialien mit einem abschließenden Übergabegespräch.

Die Zusammenarbeit:

Umfang, Ergebnisse, Termine und Honorar stimmen wir für jedes Leistungspaket vorab miteinander ab. Du setzt die vereinbarten Leistungen eigenverantwortlich mit eigener Ausstattung um und gestaltest Arbeitsort und Arbeitszeit selbst. Für Briefings, Rückfragen und Freigaben steht dir eine feste Ansprechperson zur Verfügung. Alles, was nach außen geht, gibt der Generalsekretär frei. Unser CI-Handbuch, unsere Vorlagen und Boilerplates stellen wir dir zur Verfügung.

Der voraussichtliche Gesamtumfang liegt bei bis zu 36 Leistungstagen im genannten Zeitraum. Die Beauftragung erfolgt nach Bedarf und gemeinsamer Vereinbarung. Abgerechnet wird monatlich nach Tagesnachweis mit Zuordnung zu den Leistungspaketen.

Qualifikation

Du hast mindestens drei Jahre Erfahrung in Pressearbeit, PR oder Journalismus und formulierst sicher und verständlich auf Deutsch. Du arbeitest selbstständig und kannst aussagekräftige Referenzen vorweisen. Erfahrungen mit gemeinnützigen Organisationen, eigene Kontakte zu Redaktionen sowie Kenntnisse jüdischen Lebens und der Debatte um Antisemitismus sind willkommen, ebenso Erfahrung mit Newsletter-Tools wie Brevo.

Dein Angebot:

Wir freuen uns bis zum 28. September 2026, 12 Uhr, über dein Angebot über JOIN mit:

· einem kurzen Profil (höchstens zwei Seiten) und deiner Verfügbarkeit,

· zwei Arbeitsproben und zwei Referenzprojekten mit Ansprechperson,

· deinem Stunden- und/oder Tagessatz, beim Tagessatz mit Angabe der enthaltenen Stunden,

· gerne ergänzenden Paketpreisen mit kurzer Beschreibung der enthaltenen Leistungen.

Bitte gib an, welche Aufgabenpakete du übernehmen möchtest. Preise bitten wir netto zuzüglich gegebenenfalls anfallender Umsatzsteuer anzugeben; mögliche Reise- und Nebenkosten bitte gesondert ausweisen. Fragen vorab beantwortet Rebecca Westerschulze, Bei der Auswahl berücksichtigen wir Preis, Qualität der Arbeitsproben sowie einschlägige Erfahrung und Referenzen. Ein Anspruch auf Beauftragung besteht nicht, die Kosten für die Angebotserstellung erstatten wir nicht.
